item.title: Recognize the people who keep a group going
item.summary: After signing in, group members can see the current monthly sponsor and up to 20 recent one-time contributors on the funding page.
item.details: The list shows an alias only when the supporter chooses it after seeing who can view it and for how long; otherwise it shows Anonymous. It never shows payment amounts, caps, payer identity, payment details, or refill activity.
